verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim Copilot in Word/Excel/PowerPoint can generate and iteratively refine documents, spreadsheets, and presentations via chat (copilot-docs-1, copilot-docs-2, copilot-docs-3, copilot-docs-16), but a hands-on community report directly contradicts this, describing Copilot in Word as unable to do anything but append text, create tables, search/replace, or maintain formatting (copilot-comm-4). Other reports call the Outlook summarization feature 'so bad' (copilot-comm-5) and describe general disappointment with Office-integrated Copilot (copilot-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent verification of successful iterative multi-file editing/export workflows, and resolution of the documented failure to actually edit/format documents as claimed.
